blocks.caption: The table of the Sky Sanctum, where wings are born

blocks.text: Every pair I ever flew was born on this table. It does one thing, and it does it with ceremony: it joins four pieces into living wings.

It waits in the Sky Sanctum, an island that appears far out in the End when the dragon dies for the second time. Follow the Sanctum Compass. You may break it with a pickaxe and take it home; the next dragon death grows a new one in the sanctum.

Four slots: the harness on top, the core in the middle, a wing on each side. When the four pieces match a pair and the gauges hold enough essence, click Assemble. The essence is paid, the wings take shape over four seconds, then wait in the output slot.

blocks.caption: Harness, core and two wings: Bat Wings

blocks.text: The Common Wings are the exception: leather, an elytra and two feathers, with no essence at all. Until the third dragon falls they are the only pair you can assemble, since every other piece comes from the Forge Bench.

Four gauges of 1,000 each, for Cloud, Steam, Ethereal and Intensified Essence. Drop a flask or a tank into the essence slot to pour it into its gauge. An assembly costs 100 Cloud for a rare pair, 150 Cloud and 150 Steam for an epic one, 250 Cloud, 250 Steam and 300 Ethereal for a legendary one, and 250 of each for a mythic one.
